description:
DK Construction, a company that transformed itself from a criminal organization into a legitimate corporation, is an emerging new powerhouse. 

“If I have to go through with an arranged marriage anyway, then of course it makes sense to marry into a family that can benefit mine.” 

It was only natural that I seemed young to him, considering he was eight years older than me. After our first meeting, the marriage arrangements moved forward at lightning speed. But then… 

“Why didn’t you tell me? Your husband has been jerking himself off for a whole year.” 

The way he drew in a deep breath made it seem almost as though he were taking in my scent. When his hot breath brushed against my sensitive skin, my vision immediately went hazy. I could clearly feel the wetness beginning to spill from me. 

“Haa… Is it because you’re so young? Even your scent and taste are incredibly sweet. Girls who don’t listen need to be taught a little lesson, don’t they?”
